description: Defines structures, constants, and functions for handling certificate policies in X.509 certificates, including parsing extensions like certificatePolicies, policyConstraints, and policyMappings.

classes.name: PolicyQualifierInfo
classes.description: Holds OID and qualifier data for policy qualifiers.

classes.name: PolicyInformation
classes.description: Represents a certificate policy with its OID and qualifiers.

classes.name: ParsedPolicyConstraints
classes.description: Holds optional constraints for policies, such as require_explicit_policy and inhibit_policy_mapping.

classes.name: ParsedPolicyMapping
classes.description: Represents a mapping between issuer and subject domain policies.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtension
methods.description: Parses the certificatePolicies extension and extracts policy information.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtensionOids
methods.description: Parses the certificatePolicies extension to extract policy OIDs, ignoring qualifiers if present.

methods.name: ParsePolicyConstraints
methods.description: Parses a PolicyConstraints sequence as per RFC 5280.
